hi.intent: customer greeting like hello hi good morning good evening
hi.answer: Hello! Welcome to Huatong Signal 😊 How can I help you?

thank_you.intent: customer says thank you thanks appreciate it
thank_you.answer: Thanks again for supporting Hwatel store. If you have any question or need help, we are here!

which_model.intent: customer asking which product model or product information
which_model.answer: Could you please tell me which product you are referring to? I will help you check the model.

damage.intent: customer says item arrived damaged broken defective
damage.answer: We're sorry to hear that the item arrived damaged. Could you please send us a photo so we can assist you?

how_ship.intent: customer asking shipping method how you ship delivery method
how_ship.answer: We usually ship by AliExpress Standard Shipping or Cainiao depending on your location.

shipping_time.intent: customer asking delivery time shipping time how long shipping takes
shipping_time.answer: Shipping usually takes about 7-15 days depending on your country.

tracking.intent: customer asking for tracking number or how to track order
tracking.answer: You can check the tracking number in your order page. If you want I can help you check it.

not_work.intent: customer says product not working not functioning cannot use device
not_work.answer: Sorry about that. Could you please tell us the problem or send a video so we can help you fix it?

install.intent: customer asking installation help or how to install product
install.answer: We can provide installation instructions. Please tell us which product you need help installing.

tech_support.intent: customer asking technical support troubleshooting assistance
tech_support.answer: Our technical support team will help you. Please describe the problem in detail.

return.intent: customer asking to return product replacement exchange
return.answer: If the item has a problem we can help you with return or replacement.

refund.intent: customer asking refund money back payment return
refund.answer: If there is a product issue we can help arrange a refund or replacement.

cancel_order.intent: customer asking to cancel order before shipping
cancel_order.answer: If the order has not been shipped yet we can help you cancel it.

wrong_item.intent: customer received wrong item incorrect product
wrong_item.answer: Sorry for the mistake. Please send us a photo of the item you received.

missing_parts.intent: customer says some parts missing incomplete package
missing_parts.answer: Sorry for the inconvenience. Please let us know which parts are missing.

warranty.intent: customer asking about product warranty guarantee service
warranty.answer: Our products come with warranty. Please tell us the issue and we will assist you.

price.intent: customer asking price cost discount how much
price.answer: The price is shown on the product page. If you have questions about pricing or discounts please let us know.

human.intent: customer asking to talk with human agent real person support
human.answer: Please wait a moment. Our customer service will assist you shortly.
